items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: And I remember another fine drummer too. They called Bill Matthews'

ctx.x: Well the Arnold band was Eddie Jackson I believe, I recall. Eddie Jackson. Did they have an alto horn or a baritone horn? Yeah. Alexander played, Adolph Alexander played baritone senior. That's Adolph's daddy. Tats' daddy. Living right about a block from here on the corner of me now. They don't stay there now, but they was staying there at the time. That's Tats' daddy. And he's passed. He passed too, yeah. He played baritone, he played euphonium too. I think he was an arranger. Well he used to write music and…
for fellas. Bill Matthews I guess. And I remember another fine drummer too. They called Bill Matthews'

brother. I forget his other name. They called him Bebe Matthews. You ever heard of that? Yeah, he just died didn't he? Yeah. Happy just died. But this is the older, I believe this is one of the brothers that played Manny Paris around here when they had the orchestra. Yeah, Bebe had been dead long time ago. Long time ago, but he was a fine drummer.
